metadata_fields.description: Stable identifier for the logical note or entity; independent of the filename and unchanged when the note is renamed.
Canonical human-readable identity; independent of the creation-time filename label.
Canonical note type selected from the type registry.
metadata_fields.retrieval_guidance: Type is a hard candidate restriction. Use it only when the request explicitly and safely identifies canonical note classes; semantic facets are not types and stay in the semantic query.
retrieval_examples: ideas sobre Odyssey -> no type restriction
decisiones sobre Odyssey -> no type restriction

metadata_fields.description: Timestamp when Odyssey created the note.
metadata_fields.retrieval_guidance: Odyssey note-lifecycle creation timestamp: when Odyssey created, wrote, or stored the note. Use for creé, escribí, guardé, or apunté. It is not the domain date described by the note. Serialize as timezone-aware ISO 8601 (for example 2026-08-20T00:00:00+02:00); never emit timezone-less lifecycle datetimes. Prefer half-open ranges: gte start, lt next boundary.
retrieval_examples: ¿Qué escribí ayer sobre n8n? -> created_at day range in the supplied timezone

metadata_fields.description: Timestamp of the latest Odyssey modification to the note.
metadata_fields.retrieval_guidance: Odyssey note-lifecycle modification timestamp. Use for modifiqué, actualicé, or cambié. Serialize as timezone-aware ISO 8601 (for example 2026-08-20T00:00:00+02:00); never emit timezone-less lifecycle datetimes. Prefer half-open ranges: gte start, lt next boundary.

metadata_fields.description: Named provenance object with stable human and app IDs; at least one must be non-null.
Named provenance object with stable human and app IDs; at least one must be non-null.
Positive integer incremented whenever Odyssey updates the note.
Version of the note metadata and schema format.
Core-managed lifecycle state. True means recoverable but excluded from ordinary active knowledge behavior.
Alternative names useful for entity resolution; aliases do not create separate entities.
metadata_fields.retrieval_guidance: Use deterministic exact matching only when the user explicitly asks for an exact alias. Ordinary name or entity search remains semantic.
retrieval_examples: alias exacto Ody -> aliases contains Ody

metadata_fields.description: Optional free-form tags explicitly chosen by the user or application; Core does not assign semantic meaning.

types.name: Concept
types.description: Reusable identifiable abstract subject, domain concept, or topic with semantic identity of its own that can accumulate knowledge across contexts; not a generic fallback for events, tasks, opinions, reflections, questions, arbitrary statements, or underclassified entities.

types.name: Project
types.description: Goal-oriented initiative or area of work that can accumulate knowledge and tasks.

types.name: Document
types.description: Document or document-like artifact worth representing as an independent knowledge object.

types.name: Person
types.description: Person with a reusable identity that can be referenced from personal knowledge and domain notes.

types.name: Journal Entry
types.description: Legacy diary entry retained for read compatibility. New everyday diary/journal capture belongs to the corresponding Calendar Day and must not create or repurpose journal_entry notes.

properties.description: Semantic date the legacy journal entry belongs to. Preserve this value for existing entries; new diary/journal capture is stored on the corresponding Calendar Day instead.
properties.retrieval_guidance: Legacy journal semantic date only: the date the historical diary entry refers to, not when Odyssey stored it. Serialize as YYYY-MM-DD. Use half-open ranges for years or months. New diary capture is Calendar Day content, not a journal_entry write.
retrieval_examples: entradas de diario de agosto -> entry_date August range
entradas de diario que escribí ayer -> created_at yesterday range

types.name: Calendar Day
types.description: Calendar-managed canonical day surface for literal day-owned knowledge and temporal navigation; not an ordinary semantic planner target.

properties.description: Canonical ISO date represented by this Calendar Day.
